cards.text: Moses is up on Mount Sinai, and the LORD has been laying out plans for the tabernacle: the ark, the altars, the oil, the incense. BIG plans. Now the LORD tells Moses He's picked someone to lead the work.

cards.question: Who has the LORD called by name to lead the building of the tabernacle?

cards.text: Bezalel is the son of Uri, the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah. And God doesn't just pick this man and wish him luck.

cards.question: God fills Bezalel with skill, ability and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship. What else does God fill him with?

cards.text: So what can Bezalel do? Design artistic works in gold, silver and bronze. Friend, this man is a whole workshop. Me? I do ONE thing. I press dough. And I need my mustache to help me do it.

cards.question: Gold, silver and bronze are just the start. God's plan is for Bezalel to be a master of every craft.

cards.text: But a master of every craft still can't build a whole tabernacle by himself. Trust me. I've got a planet full of cookie boxes and ONE mustache. So God gives Bezalel some help.

cards.question: Who does God select to be Bezalel's assistant?
Bezalel is from the tribe of Judah, and his assistant Oholiab is from the tribe of ___.

cards.text: God has also given skill to all the craftsmen, so they can make the Tent of Meeting, the ark with the mercy seat on it, the table, the lampstand, both altars, the basin, the holy garments for the priests, the anointing oil and the incense. Every piece is to be made according to all God has commanded Moses.

Then the LORD gives Moses a message for the Israelites, and this one isn't about gold or wood. It's about a day. A day OFF. Friend, in that junk drawer every day was a day off, and let me tell you, it was NOT relaxing.

cards.question: What does the LORD tell the Israelites they must surely keep?
The LORD says the Sabbath will be a sign between Him and the Israelites for the generations to come. It's so they may know what?

answers.text: That He is the LORD who sanctifies them
That He is the LORD who feeds them
That He is the LORD who fights for them

cards.text: Then God says, 'Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you.' And He does not treat this one lightly.

cards.question: God says anyone who profanes the Sabbath must surely be put to death.
God says that for ___ days work may be done, but the ___ day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD.

cards.text: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come. Then God says why it's a sign forever, and the reason goes all the way back to the beginning.

cards.question: Why is the Sabbath a sign between God and the Israelites forever?

answers.text: God made everything in six days and rested on the seventh
God led Israel out of Egypt and rested on the seventh
God gave the law in six days and rested on the seventh

cards.text: When the LORD has finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gives Moses something. And friend, nobody in Bezalel's workshop made this one. Not even the man who's a master of every craft.

cards.question: What does the LORD give Moses on Mount Sinai?

answers.text: Two stone tablets written by God's finger
A scroll of the law written by Moses' hand
A gold plate engraved by Bezalel's hands

findings.problem: Card 1 cites only Exodus 31:1, but it also says the LORD has picked someone to lead the work. That comes from 31:2, so the citation is narrower than what the card tells.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: Card 7 adds a reason for God choosing Oholiab: a master of every craft "can't build a whole tabernacle by himself... So God gives Bezalel some help." Exodus 31:6 says God selected Oholiab as Bezalel's assistant. It gives no reason.

rule.text: Reasons: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.

findings.problem: Nothing before card 13 helps the baker reason toward "sanctifies" over "feeds" or "fights for." The card is left to luck. Card 14's line about the Sabbath being holy comes after the question.

rule.text: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer.

findings.problem: Card 17 says the reason "goes all the way back to the beginning." That rules out the Egypt and giving-the-law answers on card 18 and gives away the creation answer.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: The right answer says "God made everything in six days." Exodus 31:17 says "the LORD made the heavens and the earth."

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.
